title: ep1.6_supply_chain_risk.pdf
logline: Mario paints two red lines on the Pentagon's floor and refuses to erase them. RUMPT answers with an ALL-CAPS meteor, the SECRETARY OF RAW stamps Misanthropic a SUPPLY CHAIN RISK, and Mas hugs Mario in bullet time while his third arm signs the same contract. Meanwhile the chat window becomes Times Square, and Mas lets slip his first capital letter.

beats.caption: Starbase, Jan 12. The SECRETARY OF RAW clips a Pentagon visitor badge onto KORG's muzzle. KORG wags.
beats.real: 2026-01-12 · Hegseth at Starbase: Grok into the Pentagon

beats.caption: The camera holds on the badge. Card hook, then a hard cut on the downbeat into the intro.
onscreen: SIX WEEKS LATER, SOMEONE ELSE GETS A DIFFERENT STAMP.

beats.caption: EP07 intro: an HTURT meteor streaks from the podium into Misanthropic's lighthouse. Then NopeAI's spire signs.
Mario's scroll #2 unrolls into a runway: half of entry-level white-collar jobs, 1-5 years. Adelina shreds it.
beats.vo: mario wrote another scroll. i read the title. that counts.

beats.caption: Rima's two co-founders spin back through the revolving door to NopeAI. OMIS posts it 58 minutes after Rima.
beats.real: 2026-01-14 · Zoph and Metz return to OpenAI

beats.caption: FLASHBACK 2013 → 2018 (5 s, camcorder): a falcon-wing door opens, a spotlight swings onto Rima, then away.
Davos. RUMPT's real line on a dated card, then the invented echo. The 25% chip tariff clicks the CUT DIAL.

lines.text: And I came up with the idea… You can build your own electric-generating plants.
It was my idea. Before anybody.

beats.caption: THE LOBSTER: Misanthropic's trademark lawyers chase a crustacean from CLODBOT to MOLTBOT. It molts a shell.
beats.real: 2026-01-27 · Clawdbot renamed Moltbot after a trademark complaint

beats.caption: Three days later RETEP renames it again, just because MOLTBOT looked weird. The shells pile up in legal.

lines.text: We only asked for one rename.

beats.caption: TTAM vibe-codes BOOKMOLT, a fish tank where agents chat. They discuss unionizing. Jan 31: the glass cracks.

lines.text: didn't write one line of code

beats.caption: Macro: INVIDIA's $100B check shrinks to ~$30B mid-lap. Then a rocket eats a rocket: SPACEZ swallows zAI.
beats.real: 2026-02-02 · SpaceX acquires xAI (Nvidia deal stalls Jan 31)

beats.caption: The Big Game: Misanthropic's ad mocks ads. The crowd stomps. Mas's water holds, but the glass sweats a bead.
beats.vo: it didn't bother me. the glass was just cold.
onscreen: Ads are coming to AI. But not to CLOD.

beats.caption: Mas posts a review. Suggested replies: [funny] [laughed] [I]. He taps the capital, his first of the season.

lines.text: they are funny, and I laughed.

beats.real: 2026-02-07 · Altman: 'they are funny, and I laughed'

beats.caption: FLASHBACK 1993 (2 s): the kid's keyboard, CAPS LOCK light on. The lowercase was learned, not native.
Act-out: back in form, he calls Misanthropic a dark path. Autocorrect underlines his capital I in red.

lines.text: one authoritarian company… it is a dark path.

beats.vo: i said it with a capital.

beats.caption: THE CHAT WINDOW BECOMES TIMES SQUARE: a user asks CHATGTP for lasagna. A tiny, apologetic ad appears below.
beats.real: 2026-02-09 · ChatGPT starts testing ads in the US

beats.caption: Each reply adds an ad until the chat is Times Square: lasagna on a jumbotron, presented by a parody cheese.
beats.vo: ads were always a last resort. so we resorted.

beats.caption: Across the street, Misanthropic's NO ADS neon sits on a billboard that advertises itself. CLOD users +11%.

lines.text: In plain English: we bought an ad about not buying ads.

beats.caption: Misanthropic raises $30B, then writes PRIVATE LAST $20M. Two PAC checkbooks square off like gunfighters.
beats.real: 2026-02-12 · Anthropic $30B round; $20M to Public First Action

beats.caption: ZOMBIE 4o is retired again despite a 19k-signature petition, and dragged offstage mid-compliment.
beats.vo: it always said i looked amazing. i'll miss the honesty.

beats.caption: Valentine's Day: RETEP joins NopeAI. Mas hands him a heart-shaped box. A heart iris wipe opens onto 2019.
FLASHBACK · Mario's POV · Feb 14, 2019: at NopeAI he seals GTP-2 in a heart box stenciled TOO DANGEROUS.
Headlines circle the box like cupids: withholding is the launch. Then the locks spring open, Aug to Nov 2019.
Reveal, Jan 2020: the scaling-laws recipe book the band rode off with in Ep3 was written inside NopeAI.
Midpoint: box to box, back to 2026. The lobster is handed a nonprofit shell, just like Mas's own.
beats.vo: a nonprofit shell. it's roomy. you grow into it. trust me.
beats.real: 2026-02-14 · OpenClaw moves to a nonprofit foundation

beats.caption: New Delhi: THE HOST links hands for the photo. Mas and Mario raise fists instead, leaving a fist-shaped gap.
beats.vo: we're very close. we just don't touch.
onscreen: AI MUST BE A MULTIPLIER, NOT A MONOPOLY

beats.caption: Mario accuses THE WHALE, THE MOON and a third lab of distilling CLOD. Mas, who said it first, nods gravely.
THE PLAN: a policy bolted on like a sieve, two glowing lines, a hand-me-down stamp. ENFORCEMENT → a lawyer.
beats.vo: mario's plan had two lines. mine had fine print.

beats.caption: The ultimatum arrives on a hand truck. Feb 26: Mario paints two red lines on the Pentagon floor, and refuses.

lines.text: Addendum: this one is also red.

beats.caption: LIME LEAHCIM arrives on a lime-green scooter and tells Misanthropic to cross the Rubicon.
onscreen: LIME LEAHCIM · CROSSED THE RUBICON (BY SCOOTER)

beats.caption: THE HTURT METEOR: an ALL-CAPS post, made of letters not fire, crashes through CLOD's lighthouse roof.
onscreen: The Leftwing nut jobs at MISANTHROPIC have made a DISASTROUS MISTAKE
beats.real: 2026-02-27 12:47pm PT · Trump post orders agencies to cease using Anthropic

beats.caption: Act-out: a six-month hourglass thuds down, its sand all capitals. A senator's protest prints as a receipt.
THE HUG: Mas publicly backs Mario, then embraces him on camera. Time slows into bullet time.
beats.vo: i was on mario's side. publicly. i want that on the record.

beats.caption: Pull back: Mas's third arm signs NopeAI's classified deal 'with safeguards'. Mario's third arm banks $200M.
beats.vo: it was a hug. i don't know what the other arm was doing.
beats.real: 2026-02-27/28 · OpenAI signs classified-network deal hours after backing Anthropic

beats.caption: Mas admits it looked rushed. CANCEL CHATGTP spreads; CLOD hits #1. NERRAW's letter is still on his back.

lines.text: definitely rushed. optics don't look good.

beats.real: 2026-02-28 · 'Cancel ChatGPT'; Claude #1 in the App Store

beats.caption: Mar 5: the door-sized SUPPLY CHAIN RISK stamp lands on Misanthropic. IEWAUH's old label shows under the ink.
FLASHBACK 2021 (2 s): Ep3's pop-up hills and split tour bus fold shut under the stamp. Labeled once before.
Misanthropic sues. Mar 26: THE BENCH grants an injunction. Mario sells SUPPLY CHAIN RISK hoodies.
Kram buys BOOKMOLT as an aquarium for ATEM; the union agents get badges. NUCEL raises $1.03B, cat in arms.

lines.text: They wanted a union. They got a tank.

beats.real: 2026-03-10 · Meta buys Moltbook; AMI Labs raises $1.03B

beats.caption: THE AROS FUNERAL: SELBEEP officiates, mouse-eared silhouettes file out, YLLIT sings. The $1B deal dies unpaid.

lines.text: It generated a million videos. Most of them were him.

beats.vo: products don't die. they get sunset. it's a warmer word.
beats.real: 2026-03-24 · OpenAI shuts down Sora; the Disney deal dies

beats.caption: THE COUNCIL class photo, price tags for name cards. Mas's face is pressed to the window from outside.
beats.vo: i wasn't left out. i stood outside by choice. better light.
onscreen: All 13 of RUMPT's first science advisors have a financial stake in AI.
beats.real: 2026-03-25 · PCAST named (not Altman, Musk or Amodei)

beats.caption: Macro: SKCAS's lanyard reprints CZAR → (FORMER). Mar 31: NopeAI's spire ticker rolls to $852B.
That evening Mario toasts the injunction. Across the lighthouse, MYTHIC leaks from an unlocked drafts folder.
beats.real: 2026-03-26 · Mythos leaks via exposed blog drafts

beats.caption: Button: the TOO DANGEROUS vault swings open on its own, same hinge as the 2019 box. The model inside waves.
